title: autoresearch: design, files, execution
subtitle: People and agents design what to do and write it down as plain files; code reads the files, runs them and writes its records back. Between the layers sit gates that can refuse; at the end the temporary data is cleaned up.

groups.label: DESIGN: people and agents decide what to do and write it down
groups.caption: The edit layer. METHOD.md cuts one cycle into P0 frame, P1 research, P2 hypotheses + plan, P3 loop and P4 close, each ended by a gate. What is the person's goes through DECISIONS.md.

groups.label: FILES: plain files in the problem folder, the only contract
groups.caption: The design layer writes them, the execution layer reads them and writes its records back; nothing else passes between the layers. Both layers read the records.

groups.label: EXECUTION: code that reads the files and runs them
groups.caption: Standard-library python with selftests. The launcher runs what the schedule says, the suites judge it, the written rule decides, the validators keep the files honest.
